freshness.rule: Any evidence used to support an Everkeep integration or ready claim must carry an authoritative producer-defined validity boundary; missing, expired, malformed, or non-forward validity is non-ready.

failure_behavior.summary_rule: Mesh summary state may never be more favorable than any required child continuity evidence.

backup_coverage: a backup mechanism for Mesh-owned durable state is configured
restore_capability: restore was tested against an isolated target
portability: clean-target import or equivalent reconstruction succeeded
documentation: current backup, restore, export, and recovery procedures are documented
provenance: evidence identifies the exact source revision when revision-bound
evidence validity is supplied by the authoritative producer or applicable policy
